notes.title: Challenge Map Update [2024/12/10]
notes.notes:
Hello!
Today's update introduces 5 new challenge maps to Dungeon Dev.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931943/ed168ee8309619205ba46f218603194dba24190f.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931943/5a298603d819040d2d6ef1761fabaf5da5fbeee3.png
These challenge maps feature a brief story cutscene set after the ending, along with more challenging levels for players to conquer. More challenging maps are planned for future updates, so stay tuned!

Additionally, as a small improvement, the ending cutscene will no longer be skipped even if the “Skip Seen Story” option is enabled.

Thank you!

notes.title: Leaderboard Update [2024/11/23]
notes.notes:
Hello!
With today's update, the leaderboard system has been added to Dungeon Dev.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931943/0ff33b70f0ba92c8caf9ff38ea45fa4e2fcf908f.png
Now, when you clear a stage, the cost information will be saved to the Steam leaderboard.
You can easily compare your performance with other players using the leaderboard graph and see how your record ranks.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931943/2f3b2aacda21fbd2f531a0f12b22a29e33f39db4.png
The leaderboard graph can also be accessed from the map selection screen.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931943/65024cf4f9e580582520151beb4e7cc8f34a528d.png
Additionally, you can check the overall records for each stage as well.


Challenge yourself to compete with other players through the leaderboard system and clear maps with even lower costs!

Thank you.

notes.title: Dungeon Dev Update [2024/11/19]
notes.notes:
Hello!
We’ve implemented an update for Dungeon Dev to incorporate the diverse feedback from our players after the game’s release.

Here are the highlights of this update


Enhanced Cutscene Effects

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931943/917cc089717fe5856a1b017263ea4ee7a3b20c7b.gif
We’ve added more dynamic movements to the Demon Lord’s dialogue illustrations, making the cutscenes feel more engaging and lively.



Stage Success and Failure Effects

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931943/e2717c969f37893cad5ff486faa70b30a3e40c2d.gif
To clearly convey the conditions for failure, the Demon Lord will now deliver a brief comment whenever a player meets the failure criteria for a stage.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931943/5802496db855065db5b55639e908a9743f82c650.gif
Of course, if you successfully design a dungeon, you’ll be met with well-deserved praise from the Demon Lord.



Bug Fixes


 Fixed a bug where a hero who dies while obtaining a healing potion could remain in a "dead yet targetable" state by monsters.
 Resolved an issue where multiple fire traps could overlap incorrectly.
 Fixed a bug where stage music would stop when the “Skip Seen Story” option was enabled on certain stages.



Thank you!

notes.title: Minor Update [2024/11/15] [2]
notes.notes:
Hello!
We have released a minor update for Dungeon Dev.


Key Updates

You can now quickly place multiple monsters and traps by selecting them and dragging while holding the left mouse button.

You can now quickly remove multiple monsters and traps by dragging while holding the right mouse button.

Thank you!

notes.title: Minor Update [2024/11/15]
notes.notes:
Hello!
We've implemented a minor update for Dungeon Dev.


Key Updates


 Fixed an issue where dialogue illustrations were misaligned to the right during cutscenes on wide-resolution monitors.
 Changed the game music type from mono to stereo.



Thank you!

notes.title: DEMO Update [2024/10/22]
notes.notes:
Hello!
We have updated the DEMO version of Dungeon Dev.


Update Highlights

Now, pressing the ESC button during gameplay will bring up the pause menu instead of returning to the map selection screen.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931943/11d55a84aaaebda6be229b78fc76fec9fc37d0cd.png

notes.title: DEMO Update [2024/10/21]
notes.notes:
Hello!
We have updated and fixed bugs in the DEMO version of Dungeon Dev.

A big thank you to the Steam user Lily-an for reporting the bugs!



Update Highlights

Fixed an issue where the game would crash when entering a story map with the option to automatically skip already-viewed cutscenes enabled.

Fixed a problem where all maps, including those not yet cleared, were unlocked.
[Unfortunately, some users may experience save data not working properly, and may have to start over from the beginning. We are very sorry for the inconvenience.]

Updated the dialogue UI to clearly indicate that the ESC button can be used to skip dialogue.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931943/7087010ab4c79e99fb26682cbb64778c6748a899.png


Thank you!

notes.title: DEMO Update [2024/10/18]
notes.notes:
Hello!
We've updated the demo version of Dungeon Dev.

For players enjoying Next Fest, this update will focus on the demo version first.
The full build, which can be accessed through Curator Connect, beta test keys, etc., will be updated at a later date.


This update focuses on improving the visual appearance of the dungeon to make it feel less empty.

The variety of dungeon floor tile patterns has been tripled, giving the dungeon a more visually diverse look.
We've also added torch objects with lighting effects.

notes.title: Demo Update [2024/09/27]
notes.notes:
Hello!
We have updated the demo version of Dungeon Dev.
Here are the key updates:


Character Collision Code Improvements

We have enhanced the physics code to make character collision detection more natural.


Cost Record Added
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931943/0f65c7a44befba0a6f84d4d0d8efea6421308426.png
After clearing a map, the game will now record how less cost you used to clear it.


Overall Map Cost Limit Increase
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931943/84f9ef09b00913d6c4990c8f64998c62effce3c2.png
The cost limit for placing monsters and traps has been raised across all maps.


Thank you!

notes.title: Demo Update [2024/09/16]
notes.notes:
Hello!

We have updated the demo version of Dungeon Dev.
Here are the main updates.


Character Pathfinding Code Improvements
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931943/8f01edfe88ab6465355fba4f188ab972a1bb8d89.gif
We’ve enhanced the existing A* algorithm-based 8-direction movement.
Now, if there are no obstacles between the character and the target, diagonal movement will be prioritized.


Windowed Mode and Story Skip Option
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931943/b5b64ec9731176e6f1e65a4088c03c0ec5157df6.png
You can now select fullscreen mode and story skip options from the options menu.
When fullscreen is turned off, the game will be played in windowed mode.
The story skip option will automatically skip the story when replaying cleared stages.


Resolution Handling Improvements

We’ve improved the code for automatic resolution adjustment in both fullscreen and windowed modes.



Thank you!

notes.title: Dungeon Dev Demo Update [2024/08/23]
notes.notes:
Hello!

We have updated the demo version of Dungeon Dev.

The main contents of this demo update are as follows:

- Revised gameplay UI
- Added demo content [Playable across 18 maps in Stage 1]
- Sound and language options
- Support for Korean, English, Japanese, and Chinese languages
- Dialogue and font data are available in CSV files to facilitate customization

For languages other than Korean, the translations were done with the help of translation tools, so there may be some awkward phrasing. 
If you could propose any translation improvements on the community hub, we would be grateful and will review them with appreciation.

Regarding the full version, content development is almost complete, and we are currently working on translations. 
After participating in the Steam Next Fest in October, we plan to officially release the game on November 15th.

Thank you!

notes.title: Dungeon Dev Demo release!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931943/fe48e95d03760ec0a7195313052dd8f306cfbaf9.png

Hello there!

We are excited to announce the release of the demo version of Dungeon Dev, a game that designs dungeons where is narrowly defeated by the heroes!

Dungeon Dev is inspired by the level design work of game developers, presenting a puzzle game concept where you design dungeons of appropriate difficulty.

While there are still many rough edges, we will continuously update and refine the game to make it more enjoyable.

Thank you for your support!
